sync.title: Sync between devices (optional)
sync.help: Find your progress on another device. No account: a secret token is enough. Needs a PyQuest server with sync; the app works fine without it.
sync.linkLabel: Or paste the token from another device
sync.tokenHelp: Keep it like a password: it gives access to your progress. If lost, it cannot be recovered (also use the file export).
sync.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the token and copy it by hand.
sync.erase: Turn off and erase the server data
sync.erased: Sync turned off, server data erased.
sync.invalidToken: This token is not valid (at least 32 characters: letters, digits, - and _).
sync.error.offline: Offline: will retry when the connection is back. Your local progress is safe.
sync.error.unavailable: No sync server available here. Your local progress is safe.
sync.error.rejected: The server rejected the data sent.
sync.error.invalid: The data received from the server is invalid and was ignored.
